criteria.statement: Signing up sends one welcome email to the new user through the mail connection

check.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { signup } from "./src/signup.js"; const sent = []; const mailer = { send: async (m) => void sent.push(m) }; await signup({ email: "ada@example.com", name: "Ada" }, { mailer }); assert.equal(sent.length, 1); assert.equal(sent[0].to, "ada@example.com"); assert.match(sent[0].subject, /welcome/i);'

criteria.statement: An invalid address is refused, as before
